title: Academic Calendar 2026-27 - Odd Semester - First Year
text:
Academic Calendar: Odd Semester 2026-27
Applicable to: First Year B.Tech, M.Tech and MCA.
Official AKGEC Academic Calendar.
Student Induction Program: 17 August 2026.
Commencement of Classes: 31 August 2026.
Sessional Test: 21-26 September 2026.
Distribution of Corrected Answer Scripts: 1 October 2026.
Mid Term Lab Assessment: 5-9 October 2026.
End Term Lab Assessment: 16-27 November 2026.
Last Day of Teaching: 27 November 2026.
Pre-University Test: 30 November-11 December 2026.
Submission of Pre-University Test Marks: 17 December 2026.
AKTU End Semester Theory and Practical Examinations: To be announced.
